item: Row 365: the frozen-renderer scanner charges a caller that hands t()/tf() output to its own writing closure
summary: A unit that hands translator output to a closure of its own that writes it into a node (const say = (m) => { out.textContent = m; }; say(t(...))) was invisible to the row 352 scan: the closure had no translator and the caller no sink. The caller is now a hit when a call to such a closure (declared inside it, with a sink and no marker) has a translator call among its arguments; a closure handed a number or the server's words charges nothing, a closure that marks its node or writes through ooLive is not a writer, a top-level namesake is not a closure, and the usual exemptions still apply. Fixtures for each case. Five new list entries, each read by hand: app-ai-tools.js qualifyBulkStart, app-climate.js climateFetch, app-diagnostics.js downloadFieldData, unattendedLog, unattendedStart. The docstring now names two cases no source scan sees: a top-level builder that translates inside itself (_chronoRender's summary) and a render handed to ooLive that returns text translated once outside the call.
